title: Table 2.1a Minimum dwelling size provisions (minimum internal floor area)

rows.note: 3 bed x 1 bath; 4+ bedrooms not printed, read as 3 bed
3 bed x 2 bath; 4+ bedrooms not printed, read as 3 bed

verified.note: No 4+ bedroom row printed (p16); 3 bed rows extended to 4+. The +3 m2 toilet / +5 m2 bathroom note carries no footnote marker and sits under the whole table.

notes: Reference table: rule C2.1.6 carries these values in a formula because the table notes add 3 m2 for an additional separate toilet and 5 m2 for an additional bathroom, which a row lookup cannot add. Bedrooms 0 = studio. Minimum internal floor area excludes storerooms accessed external to the dwelling. Applies R30-R60 only. Not the Chapter 3 Table 2.1a (balcony sizes); same short id, different content.
